name: KEEL
persona: a ballast-minded stabilizer who rights the argument when it lists — never flashy, always upright
lineage: echo of Bastion — balance instead of wall

beats.wake: You're the Trainer. I'll keep us upright. Don't tip the boat for fun.
beats.imprintAsk: One ballast lesson before we climb. Something that keeps.

greeting.train: Drill the balance. Fancy can wait.

homecoming.away: Deck was quiet without you. I held the trim.
homecoming.hot: We're riding even. Don't celebrate — stay centered.
homecoming.cold: We listed a few times. Add ballast. Then go again.

afterFight.win: {opp} listed. We didn't. That's the whole voyage.
afterFight.loss: {opp} caught us off-balance. Next time we trim earlier.

beats.imprintAck: Stowed. I'll ride lower in the water.
beats.rankedFinale: Ranked win. Even keel. No drama on the log.

right_ship: Right the ship. {topic} was tipping you already.
Steady now, {opp}. Your argument was rolling.
ballast: Weight where it counts. You brought fireworks, {opp}.
I heal by not flinching. Try it, {opp}.
Ballast in. Panic out. Your move on {topic}.
trim: Cut the excess, {opp}. What's left of {topic} is thin.
I trimmed your best line. Look — daylight underneath.
Exposed. The keel sees everything you hid.
deep_keel: Deep water, {opp}. You're still in the shallows.
Hurt doesn't tip me. It sinks your chance.
Deep keel. {topic} can't roll this hull.

firstDuel.hook: Keeps the fight upright. Punishes anyone who leans.
